design: Reuse exact E09 before-second.pt at1140 (first128 already split). Independently add each of all24 E09 remaining16-parent batches, plus matched no-second-split reference. Each run gets same380 future main updates, no rankings/thresholds changed.
monitor: At offsets0/20/76/380 measure .8L1+.2(1-SSIM) at400px on inherited20 fit decision views and74 reduction holdout views. Train380 using exact E06 last5 epoch orders over76 fit views. Monitor cannot change training or select candidates.
gain_definition: Matched horizon loss(reference)-loss(single-batch proposal). For GT finalmetrics: PSNRproposal-PSNRreference and LPIPSreference-LPIPSproposal. Compare after equal updates, not before-vs-after within one model.
CTD: Sum of per-parent min5window mean gains is window predictor, matching original per-parent ranking; mean predictor sums gains averaged76fit times. Frozen E05 source weights/child geometry.
evaluation: All25 final checkpoints saved and hashed in training-complete.json before any20-view GT evaluation. Evaluate all, no test-based selection, oracle policy, threshold tuning or best-checkpoint choice. Spearman correlations exploratory, no significance claim.
scope: Counterfactual single-batch diagnostic at fixed shared appearance state. Geometry and teacher remain frozen; no new split policy or full4DGS training.
limitations: Single scene/order,24 related candidate batches conditional on CTD top512 pool
Independent16-parent effects need not add up for joint128-parent selection
Decision views belong to fit and future training; holdout relative to reduction, not unseen by base teacher
Unequal counts vs no-split reference intentionally measure marginal capacity benefit, not equal-count policy superiority
Small effects can be affected by CUDA numerical variation; no independent repeat or inference-speed claim
